Vera Linux daemon third-party notices

This inventory covers the resolved normal and build dependencies of verad for
x86_64-unknown-linux-gnu with default features disabled. Build-time tools are
included conservatively; inclusion does not assert that every package is linked
into the executable. The declared license expressions are package metadata.

upstream source trees, the source URL includes the reviewed revision. Aurora's
package records a dirty source tree; see its package-specific notice below.
